This highlights a blind spot in the perceptual auditor for document-specific artifacts. The edges do show slight 'haloing' or softness typical of AI generation, so Severity 2.0 is appropriate.

This indicates the visual pattern of grid-like gibberish strongly resembles a crossword, further confirming the structural failure of the text generation. This is not a new visual artifact per se, but strong evidence of the 'text_gibberish' severity.
